decision: Retain as preferred brightness baseline for subsequent checks; do not infer final building acceptance.
evidence_storage: Unmodified original screenshots archived locally outside Git; public record contains hashes and observations only.

observations.Day: Concrete panel joints, dark glass, radiator edges and painted transformer surfaces retain substantially more visible detail; brown insulators remain distinct.
observations.Sunset: Warm light changes the colour cast while panel divisions, glass and electrical equipment remain readable.
observations.Night: Equipment and facade darken with the environment; the earlier broad bright appearance is reduced. This is the same material in Night mode, not authored night lighting.

limits: All three new screenshots show Vehicle mode. Its exact effect is unverified; this alone does not invalidate the observed improvement. Keep mode fixed within future comparisons.
View framing differs from the earlier baseline; this is a qualitative appearance review, not a controlled pixel measurement.
The submaterial selector is unselected; the three entries were confirmed in the previous corrected-package review, not re-enumerated here.
Baked normal variants, unseen faces, distance performance, dedicated night materials and gameplay remain untested.

object_type_research.status: Exact selector behavior not established by checked documentation.
